battle.name: 尼日利亞內戰
battle.brief: 尼日利亞內戰於一九六七年七月爆發，聯邦軍與比夫拉武裝在拉各斯及周邊城鎮交火，初期局勢迅速擴及尼日利亞河谷，是冷戰時期西非的重要內戰。英軍制式恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle）於一八五八年列裝，屬於英國陸軍的栓動步槍體系。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle）屬英國陸軍栓動步槍序列，以單發射擊提供步兵遠距火力，是英軍制式步兵武器體系中的一員。

countries: 1967年7月6日以前，戰區是英國殖民統治於1960年結束後留下的尼日利亞聯邦；聯邦政府以拉各斯為首都，轄有北部、西部與中西部等地，並逐步接管東部區。比夫拉源自東部區，7月6日在埃努古宣布成立比夫拉共和國，奧古朱武任國家元首兼武裝力量最高指揮官，首都先設埃努古，埃努古失守後遷至烏穆阿希亞。聯邦宣稱對東部區擁有完整主權，比夫拉則控制東部區的大部分地方，並於1968年初向中西部推進，一度取得貝寧城、瓦里與拉各斯，但始終未能控制北部。戰區東面是喀麥隆，西面是當時仍稱達荷美的國家，南面為幾內亞灣與尼日爾河三角洲水道；拉各斯、哈里科特港、貝寧、奧尼查、阿巴、周里與烏穆阿希亞構成主要補給線和戰線節點。英國後來以秘密渠道支援聯邦，法國方面的秘密供應網絡則曾支援比夫拉；周邊國家提供跨境運輸或外交空間，但不是主要交戰方。
countriesEn: Before 6 July 1967, the theatre was the Federation of Nigeria left after Britain ended colonial rule in 1960. The federal government retained Lagos as its capital and governed the northern, western, and mid-western regions while progressively asserting control over the eastern region. Biafra originated in the eastern region and was proclaimed as the Republic of Biafra at Enugu on 6 July, with Chukwuma Odumegwu Ojukwu as head of state and supreme commander. Its first capital was Enugu, and its headquarters moved to Umuahia after the fall of Enugu. Lagos, Port Harcourt, Benin City, Onitsha, Aba, Owerri, and Umuahia formed the principal logistical nodes and axes of operations. Britain subsequently supplied the federal side through covert channels, while French-connected clandestine networks supplied Biafra. Cameroon and Dahomey bordered the theatre and provided transit routes or diplomatic space, but neither was a principal belligerent.
people: 尼日利亞內戰的高層決策集中在奧古朱武、埃芬貢與戈翁三人身上。奧古朱武原為東部區軍政首長，他在聯邦收回地方軍指揮權、限制東部武裝力量的背景下建立比夫拉政府，兼任政治領袖與最高軍事指揮者；他的判斷直接造成政府遷都、戰役方向及外交策略。菲利普·埃芬貢是比夫拉陸軍參謀長與武裝部隊實際指揮者，1969年後承擔更多前線及軍政協調工作，最後代表比夫拉方面接受聯邦的投降條件。雅庫布·戈旺自1966年8月起主持聯邦軍政，採取海上封鎖、空軍打擊與地面推進並行的政策。聯邦方面，馬少將大衛·杰米貝翁先後統率師級與集團軍級部隊，穆罕馬杜·布卡里則以第2師指揮官身分參與由拉各斯向奧尼查方向推進的戰役；英國軍事顧問與飛行員也進入聯邦指揮體系。比夫拉方面另聘有外籍飛行員及技術顧問，但 aircraft補充與後勤能力不足以改變地面補給劣勢。
peopleEn: The highest-level decisions of the war centred on Chukwuma Odumegwu Ojukwu, Philip Effiong, and Yakubu Gowon. Ojukwu had been the military-political head of the eastern region and created the Biafran government as federal authorities took control of local forces and restricted the eastern armed establishment; his judgements determined the relocation of the government, the direction of campaigns, and diplomatic strategy. Philip Effiong served as the Biafran chief of staff and effective commander of the armed forces, assuming more of the front-line and military-administrative burden from 1969 and ultimately accepting the federal terms of surrender. Yakubu Gowon headed the federal government from August 1966 and pursued a combination of maritime blockade, air attack, and ground advance. On the federal side, Major-General David Jemibewon commanded divisional and later army-level formations, while Muhammadu Buhari led the 2nd Division during operations from Lagos toward Onitsha; British advisers and aircrew also served within the federal chain of command. Biafra employed foreign pilots and technical advisers, but their aircraft support and logistical reach could not compensate for the weakness of its ground-supply system.
kits: 聯邦步兵的火力骨幹包括比利時FN FAL步槍，口徑7.62×51公厘；英國史丁林衝鋒槍，口徑9×19公厘；以及.303英制布倫輕機槍。支援火力有西德G3戰鬥步槍、比利時FN MAG通用機槍、英制25磅野戰砲、17磅反裝甲砲、81公厘迫擊砲與2英吋迫擊砲；少量韋克斯Mk XI戰車及戴姆勒Dingo裝甲車提供偵察與護衛。運輸主要依靠Land Rover Series II及IIA越野車、Bedford RL系列載重車，並以無線電電台連接前線與補給站。聯邦航空隊使用de Havilland Vampire FB.5、Gloster Meteor F.4及Hawker Hunter FGA.9執行戰鬥、偵察與對地攻擊；英方後段投入的Blackburn Buccaneer S.2與English Electric Canberra B.2則負責較重的攻擊任務。比夫拉可使用的FAL、史丁林、布倫機槍、英制迫擊砲與25磅砲，部分來自外部供應，部分來自繳獲；其空軍曾使用de Havilland Dove與Aermacchi SF.260等輕型機，但數量有限。不同步槍分別依賴7.62×51、9公厘及.303彈藥，炮兵與迫擊砲亦需不同口徑供應，彈藥消耗、車輛可行走性及前線儲備不足，長期限制比夫拉的持續射擊能力。
kitsEn: The core of federal infantry firepower consisted of the Belgian FN FAL rifle in 7.62 × 51 mm, the British Sterling submachine gun in 9 × 19 mm, and the .303-inch Bren light machine gun. Supporting weapons included the West German G3 battle rifle, Belgian FN MAG general-purpose machine gun, British 25-pounder field gun, 17-pounder anti-tank gun, 81 mm mortar, and 2-inch mortar. Small numbers of Vickers Mk 11 tanks and Daimler Dingo armoured cars provided reconnaissance and escort. Land Rover Series II and IIA cross-country vehicles, Bedford RL trucks, and field radio stations formed the main transport and command network. The federal air arm used de Havilland Vampire FB.5, Gloster Meteor F.4, and Hawker Hunter FGA.9 aircraft for combat, reconnaissance, and ground attack. British Blackburn Buccaneer S.2 and English Electric Canberra B.2 aircraft later provided heavier strike capability. Biafra used FAL rifles, Sterling submachine guns, Bren guns, British mortars, and 25-pounder guns obtained through outside supply or capture. Its air force operated limited numbers of light aircraft including the de Havilland Dove and Aermacchi SF.260. Separate ammunition requirements for 7.62 × 51 mm, 9 mm, and .303 ammunition, together with artillery and mortar stocks, imposed severe burdens on ammunition consumption, vehicle mobility, and forward reserves.
tactics: 聯邦的戰略核心是海上封鎖與縱深航空打擊配合地面攻勢。海軍巡邏封鎖比夫拉控制的港口與三角洲水道，空軍攻擊機場、補給點及指揮節點，使比夫拉難以取得成批外援；地面部隊則沿拉各斯至貝寧、奧尼查至周里，以及哈里科特港經阿巴至烏穆阿希亞的公路軸線推進。聯邦常以炮兵與空軍先行削弱據點，再由步兵佔領，必要時圍困而不強攻，以降低立即攻城的代價。比夫拉採取中央指揮與分散兵力並存的方式，把軍隊編成多個師級單位，並以小分隊、游擊隊及臨時突擊支隊在道路、林地和城郊活動；突擊的主要目標是彈藥庫、燃料車隊、機場與孤立哨所，而非正面消耗聯邦主力。其1968年西進利用聯邦中西部兵力分散的缺口，奪取貝寧、瓦里與拉各斯，但補給線拉長後無法長期維持西線。聯邦封鎖使比夫拉只能消耗前線存彈，聯邦則逐步把砲兵、裝甲、空軍與道路補給集中到同一戰役；因此，比夫拉能以伏擊和突擊延長戰事，卻始終難以取得與聯邦同等強度的持續作戰能力。
tacticsEn: The federal strategy centred on combining maritime blockade with air interdiction and ground advance. Naval patrols restricted Biafran ports and the waterways of the Niger Delta, while aircraft attacked airfields, supply points, and command nodes to impede large-scale foreign deliveries. Ground forces advanced along the Lagos–Benin–Onitsha axis and the Port Harcourt–Aba–Owerri–Umuahia road network. Artillery and air strikes usually prepared objective areas before infantry occupation, and the federal command sometimes preferred blockade and siege to avoid immediate frontal assault. Biafra combined formal central command with dispersed operations, organizing the army into several divisional formations while using smaller detachments, irregular units, and temporary striking groups along roads, wooded country, and approaches to towns. Raids concentrated on ammunition depots, fuel convoys, airfields, and isolated posts rather than direct attacks on the federal main body. The western advance of 1968 exploited gaps in federal mid-western deployments and took Benin City, Warri, and Lagos, but the extended line could not be supplied indefinitely. The blockade compelled Biafra to consume forward ammunition stocks, while the federal side increasingly concentrated artillery, armour, air power, and road transport within the same theatre. Biafran ambushes and raids could therefore prolong the war, but could not create the sustained combat capacity of the federal army.
data: 1967年7月6日，奧古朱武在埃努古宣布比夫拉獨立，立即接管東部區政府與軍隊指揮；聯邦隨即中止談判、封鎖東部海岸，並以從拉各斯及哈里科特港調出的部隊沿公路進攻。7月至9月，雙方在埃努古、恩蘇卡及其外圍反覆爭奪道路和補給點，聯邦空軍轟炸埃努古區的機場與陣地，地面部隊則逐步壓縮市區控制。10月4日聯邦進入埃努古，奧古朱武把政府與指揮中心遷往烏穆阿希亞；11月初，哈里科特港也落入聯邦控制，比夫拉退守內陸與三角洲上游。比夫拉在1967年底整編武裝力量，陸續建立編號達十二的師級單位，但各師補給多靠分散徵集。1968年1月，比夫拉集中西部戰線兵力，奪取貝寧城、瓦里及拉各斯，一度切斷聯邦在西南部的陸路樞紐；聯邦隨後反擊，重新控制貝寧，並把進攻重點轉回拉各斯與奧尼查方向。7月26日至8月6日，比夫拉軍隊進攻奧尼查，試圖奪取聯邦在東部的交通中心，但正面與夜間突擊均未突破聯邦防線。9月聯邦重新進入拉各斯，10月又由北面奪回奧尼查，使兩條主要公路重新連接聯邦後方。1969年，比夫拉在奧尼查周圍發動反攻，試圖切斷聯邦東進縱隊，但受到聯邦砲兵與航空兵力壓制；聯邦其後沿阿巴、周里至烏穆阿希亞方向推進，春夏間控制阿巴，並把戰線推到烏穆阿希亞外圍。12月23日，英國皇家空軍的Blackburn Buccaneer S.2攻擊比夫拉位於烏利的主要機場與指揮設施，區內指揮中心再次遷移。1970年1月，比夫拉以第12師等部隊向烏穆阿希亞外圍及聯邦東中部縱深發動最後攻勢，試圖利用聯邦戰線拉長的缺口；聯邦部隊先在周里方向遏止並反擊，1月6日控制周里。1月15日，聯邦進入烏穆阿希亞，埃芬貢率比夫拉方面接受投降，奧古朱武則離開比夫拉前往科特迪瓦。聯邦由此取得對原比夫拉全部territory的控制，戰事實際結束。
dataEn: On 6 July 1967, Ojukwu proclaimed Biafran independence at Enugu and took control of the eastern regional government and armed forces. The federal government immediately ended negotiations, blockaded the eastern coast, and moved troops from Lagos and Port Harcourt along the main roads. From July through September, the two sides contested roads and supply points around Enugu and Nsukka. Federal aircraft bombed the Enugu airfield area and positions while ground forces gradually tightened control of the city. The federal army entered Enugu on 4 October, and Ojukwu moved the government and command centre to Umuahia. Port Harcourt also came under federal control in early November, leaving Biafra concentrated inland and farther up the delta. During the remainder of 1967, Biafra reorganized its armed forces and established divisional formations numbered as high as the 12th, although their supplies came from dispersed local collection. In January 1968, Biafra concentrated forces on the western front and took Benin City, Warri, and Lagos, temporarily disrupting the federal road system in the southwest. The federal side counterattacked, regained Benin City, and shifted its main effort back towards Lagos and Onitsha. Between 26 July and 6 August, Biafran forces attacked Onitsha in an attempt to seize the federal transport centre in the east, but frontal operations and night attacks failed to break the federal position. Federal forces re-entered Lagos in September and recovered Onitsha in October, reconnecting the principal roads with the federal rear. During 1969, Biafra counterattacked around Onitsha in an effort to sever the advancing federal columns, but federal artillery and air power disrupted the operation. Federal forces then advanced along the Aba–Owerri–Umuahia axis, took Aba during the spring and summer, and pushed the front to the approaches of Umuahia. On 23 December, Royal Air Force Blackburn Buccaneer S.2 aircraft attacked Biafra's principal airfield and command facilities at Uli, prompting another relocation of the command centre. In January 1970, Biafran formations including the 12th Division launched a final offensive towards Umuahia and the federal interior, seeking to exploit an overextended front. Federal troops checked and reversed the movement, taking Owerri on 6 January. On 15 January, federal forces entered Umuahia and Effiong accepted surrender on behalf of the Biafran side. Ojukwu left for Côte d'Ivoire, and federal control of all former Biafran territory was established.
cause: 戰爭的根源不能簡化成單一族群因素，而是聯邦制度、軍隊指揮與1966年政治危機逐層累積的結果。獨立後的尼日利亞由地區、族群與資源差異顯著的多個區域組成，聯邦中央與各區之間始終存在權力及資源分配矛盾；殖民時期留下的軍區化徵募制度，又使士兵和尉官對地方及族群具有不同歸屬。1966年1月15日，軍人推翻民選政府；7月29日北部軍官再度奪權；8月8日南部軍官發動反擊並殺死伊羅西，聯邦軍政高層與北部士兵間的互信因此崩解。各區武庫中的武器散失，軍官在不同團體之間轉換效忠，以及1966年的族群暴力與相互恐懼，使中央軍隊、地方部隊和地方政治人物之間形成直接對抗。1967年1月聯邦撤銷區政府、任命軍事行政官員後，聯邦軍隊整合、地方指揮權及武器管制成為具體爭議；奧古朱武與聯邦當局又就第五師等單位的指揮和駐地問題反覆僵持。比夫拉宣言既是奧古朱武維持東部軍政自主權的行動，也是防止自身部隊被解除武裝的防禦措施。東部石油收入、外部武器來源及外國軍事援助則使衝突獲得延長的資源條件；英法兩國不同的秘密介入，又把原本已高度軍事化的內政對抗帶入更廣的國際競爭。
causeEn: The war cannot be reduced to a single ethnic cause; it resulted from the accumulation of federal institutions, military command arrangements, and the political crisis of 1966. Post-independence Nigeria consisted of regions with marked ethnic, political, and economic differences, while the colonial regional recruitment system left soldiers and junior officers with loyalties that did not always match the new federal command. On 15 January 1966, military officers overthrew the elected government; northern officers seized power again on 29 July; and southern officers counterattacked on 8 August, killing Ironsi and destroying trust between the federal high command and many northern troops. Weapons in regional depots, officers shifting between competing factions, and the ethnic violence and mutual fear of 1966 turned the federal army, regional formations, and local politicians into direct opponents. After the federal government abolished the regional governments and appointed military administrators in January 1967, army integration, local command authority, and weapons control became immediate disputes. Ojukwu and the federal authorities also deadlocked over the command and location of formations such as the 5th Division. The declaration of Biafra was therefore both Ojukwu's effort to preserve eastern military-political autonomy and a defensive measure against the disarmament of eastern forces. Eastern oil revenues, external weapons, and foreign military assistance gave the conflict resources that could prolong it, while divergent covert British and French involvement drew the militarized domestic dispute into a wider international contest.
impact: 這場戰爭首先重塑了聯邦軍的戰略與組織。聯邦由以平時師級部隊及分散後勤為主的體制，轉向以海上封鎖、空軍縱深打擊、砲兵集中和集團軍作戰相互配合的體系；西非英式輕步兵編制與現代砲兵、裝甲、航空及電子通信並存，軍隊的中央集權程度明顯提高。比夫拉則以分散師級單位、游擊支隊和反覆遷移指揮中心抵抗正面優勢，其拖延作戰延長了聯邦必須投入的時間與資源，卻無法補充被封鎖切斷的外援。外部援助顯示，戰爭一旦獲得跨境武器與外籍飛行員支持，地方衝突便會國際化；英國對聯邦的援助逐步增加，法國及其他渠道對比夫拉的秘密支援也影響了談判與外交接觸。戰爭結束後，聯邦重新掌握東部石油設施、港口和內陸公路，軍隊規模及政治地位反而擴大；比夫拉的制度則全面解散，聯邦軍事政府得以在統一國土及強化軍隊政治角色的基礎上延續其統治。現存戰後檔案不足以支持一個可交叉核驗的雙方精確傷亡總數，因此本實錄不列來源互相衝突的總數。
impactEn: The war first transformed federal military strategy and organization. A system based mainly on peacetime divisional formations and dispersed logistics became one in which maritime blockade, deep air attack, concentrated artillery, and army-level operations reinforced one another. West African light infantry inherited from British practice operated alongside modern artillery, armour, aviation, and electronic communications, while the centralization of the armed forces became markedly greater. Biafra relied on dispersed divisional formations, guerrilla detachments, and repeated relocation of command centres against conventional superiority. That method prolonged the time and resources required by the federal side, but it could not replace external aid severed by the blockade. Foreign assistance demonstrated that a local conflict with cross-border weapons and foreign pilots would become internationalized. British support for the federal side increased as the war continued, while French and other covert channels supplying Biafra affected negotiations and diplomatic contacts. After the war, the federal government regained the eastern oil installations, ports, and inland roads; the armed forces expanded, and their political role increased. Biafran institutions were completely dismantled, allowing the federal military government to continue governing a unified territory on the basis of a strengthened military establishment. Surviving records do not support a single cross-verifiable total for casualties on either side, so this account does not repeat conflicting aggregate figures.
result: 聯邦取得明確的軍事與政治勝利。1970年1月15日，聯邦部隊控制烏穆阿希亞並接受埃芬貢代表比夫拉方面的投降；原比夫拉師級部隊有的解編，有的被聯邦分別整編或解散，其指揮文件、武器及剩餘裝備落入聯邦一方。奧古朱武同日離往科特迪瓦，其後前往阿根廷，未能重新建立比夫拉國家。聯邦重新控制原東部區全部領土，撤換比夫拉行政與軍事機構，並將其重組為聯邦軍事行政體系；哈里科特港、奧尼查、阿巴、周里與烏穆阿希亞重新納入同一補給和交通網。戰後聯邦軍政繼續執政，軍隊在國家政治中的地位因而更加突出。比夫拉共和國作為國家實體終結，未能取得持續而廣泛的外交承認；聯邦則獲得領土完整與軍事勝果，但原有政治與軍隊問題並未因戰爭結束而全部消失。戰役實錄至此以聯邦接收比夫拉投降、占領最後指揮中心及解散其武裝機構收束。
resultEn: The federal side achieved a clear military and political victory. On 15 January 1970, federal troops occupied Umuahia and accepted the surrender offered on behalf of Biafra by Effiong. Former Biafran divisional units were demobilized, separately reorganized, or absorbed in different ways by the federal army, while command documents, weapons, and remaining equipment passed to federal control. Ojukwu left for Côte d'Ivoire on the same day and later travelled to Argentina, but was unable to reconstitute the Biafran state. The federal government regained the entire former eastern region, replaced Biafran administrative and military institutions, and incorporated Port Harcourt, Onitsha, Aba, Owerri, and Umuahia into a unified supply and transport network. Federal military government continued after the war, and the armed forces acquired a more prominent political position. The Republic of Biafra ceased to exist as a state and did not obtain durable, broadly recognized diplomatic standing. The federal side secured territorial unity and military success, although the political and command problems that had produced the conflict were not all resolved by the war. The military record therefore closes with federal acceptance of the Biafran surrender, occupation of the last command centre, and dissolution of the defeated armed structure.
